correctness.rationale: Embedded compactness provides positive separation of nonlocal parameter pairs, so all sufficiently short chords correspond to a unique small midpoint arc u with q(s,u) strictly increasing. The midpoint Jacobian equals one, giving F(r)=2L⁻²∫u_r(s)ds. Symmetric Taylor through u⁵ gives q²/u²=1−a u²/12+(b/360−a″/480)u⁴+O(u⁶), a=|T′|², b=|T″|²; odd-series inversion gives u_r=r+a r³/24+(35a²−8b+6a″)r⁵/5760+O(r⁷). Periodicity kills ∫a″, yielding c5. Frenet expansion gives the torsion defect, with κ>0 needed to infer planarity from zero energy. For γ_m, length→2π, ∫|T″|²≈πm while ∫|T′|⁴=O(1), proving the unbounded negative coefficient. Independent analytic torus loop calculations converge to predicted c5; these do not replace the universal local expansion.
residual_risks: C⁷ and embeddedness are needed for uniform per-curve Taylor/localization.
C² convergence does not permit interchanging frequency and small-r limits.
